description: This file is a jQuery plugin module defining traversal methods such as parent, children, siblings, and related functions, extending jQuery's prototype with traversal capabilities.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if the set contains elements that have the target as a descendant.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor that matches the selector.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Determines the index of an element within its siblings or in a set.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds elements to the set based on a selector or element.

methods.name: addBack
methods.description: Adds the previous set of elements to the current set.

methods.name: parent
methods.description: Gets the parent of each element.

methods.name: parents
methods.description: Gets all ancestors of each element.

methods.name: parentsUntil
methods.description: Gets all ancestors up to a certain element.

methods.name: nextUntil
methods.description: Gets following siblings up to a certain element.

methods.name: prevUntil
methods.description: Gets preceding siblings up to a certain element.

methods.name: contents
methods.description: Gets the content document of iframe or child nodes.
